title: A child key reads a variable of its parent with parent.<name>
proves: a child <key script="parent.zone"> that reads a <variable> of the parent is ready, as the run is; the variable is no field, so it joins nothing, and the foreign key parent.depot_id groups the child rows (#442 T1)
parent.<a source column that no key and no columns= declares> is rejected before the run, and the remediation names both working forms
both working forms give the same rows: a parent <key script="this.region">, or the column listed in columns=; the foreign_key role picks the copy that groups
without the key copy, the foreign_key role names the copy it needs

negatives.name: a_variable_copy_is_no_foreign_key
negatives.message: A nested foreign-key role must copy the exact parent field using parent.field.

negatives.name: an_undeclared_source_column_is_no_field
negatives.message: Parent reference names an unknown field.
negatives.remediation: Declare a source column in the parent as <key name="region" script="this.region"/>, or list it in columns=.

patch.old:
<key name="city" script="this.city"/>
        <generate name="vans" count="2">
            <key name="depot_id" script="parent.depot_id"/>
            <key name="zone" script="parent.zone"/>
patch.new:
<key name="city" script="this.city"/>
        <key name="region" script="this.region"/>
        <generate name="vans" count="2">
            <key name="depot_id" script="parent.depot_id"/>
            <key name="zone" script="parent.region"/>

patch.old:
distribution="ordered" count="3">
        <!-- A variable of the parent is no output field; a child copies it with parent.zone. -->
        <variable name="zone" script="this.region"/>
        <key name="depot_id" script="int(this.depot_id)"/>
        <key name="city" script="this.city"/>
        <generate name="vans" count="2">
            <key name="depot_id" script="parent.depot_id"/>
            <key name="zone" script="parent.zone"/>
patch.new:
distribution="ordered" count="3" columns="depot_id, city, region">
        <key name="depot_id" script="int(this.depot_id)"/>
        <generate name="vans" count="2">
            <key name="depot_id" script="parent.depot_id"/>
            <key name="zone" script="parent.region"/>
